## Fire Whale (CR 10)

**XP** 9600  
N Huge magical beast (extraplanar, fire)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** blindsight 120 ft.; Perception +14  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 9, flat-footed 18 (+1 Dex, +10 natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 136 (12d10+72)  
**Fort** +14; **Ref** +9; **Will** +7  
**Immune** fire  
**Weakness** vulnerability to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** Swim 40 ft.  
**Melee** bite +22 (3d6+12), tail slap +19 (1d6+6)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** scalding blast  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 35, **Dex** 13, **Con** 23, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +26; **CMD** 37  
**Feats** Awesome Blow, Diehard, Endurance, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Power Attack  
**Skills** Perception +14, Swim +29; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception  
**SQ** hold breath  

**Special Abilities**

 **Hold Breath (Ex)** A fire whale can hold its breath for 8 x its Constitution score before it risks drowning.  

 **Scalding Blast (Su)** As a full round action, a fire whale can release a blast of superheated air from its blowhole that scalds or burns those contacting it. The cone-shaped blast has a range of 60 ft and deals 12d6 points of damage. A successful DC 22 Reflex save halves the damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.
